answer: Splitting into 7 separate vaults demands a separate funded beacon account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The shale explorer makes public the whole merge tree. That is 39 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
